abilities.name: Fortifying Brew
abilities.description: Chen drinks from his keg, gaining 50 Brew and 190 temporary Shields per second, up to a maximum of 570 while drinking. Shields persist for 4 seconds after he stops drinking.; 7; trait

fields.tickrate: - Shields: 2.0 per second (x8) - Brew: 8.0 per second (x32)

abilities.name: Flying Kick
abilities.description: Kick through target enemy, dealing 130 damage.

fields.notes: Chen is positioned on the opposite side of the target upon landing.

abilities.name: Keg Smash
abilities.description: Deal 50 damage and soak enemies in Brew for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 10%. After 1.25 seconds, the Slow is increased to 40%. After being used, this ability becomes Breath of Fire. Breath of Fire Deal damage and Ignite Brew-soaked enemies.

fields.notes: Igniting enemies also extend the duration of Brew-soaked debuff by 1.5 seconds. Brew-soaked cannot be removed by cleansing the associated Slow.

abilities.name: Keg Smash - Breath of Fire
abilities.description: Breathe a cone of flames, dealing 40 damage. Enemies soaked in Brew are Ignited, dealing 171 additional damage over 6 seconds and adding 1.5 seconds to the duration of the Slow from Keg Smash. After being used or after 6 seconds, this Ability becomes Keg Smash. Keg Smash Damage and Slow enemies.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Damage over Time (Ignited)
fields.notes: Igniting enemies also extends the duration of Brew-soaked debuff by 1.5 seconds. The cooldown does not start counting until Breath of Fire has been used or it has expired.

abilities.name: Stagger
abilities.description: Damage taken over the next 3 seconds is prevented. Once this effect ends, Chen receives 75% of the damage taken over 5 seconds. This damage cannot be modified.

fields.notes: Damage over time can still be prevented, absorbed or dispelled through specific Abilities and effects. Chen can die from self-damage, which grants the enemy team the normal amount of XP and takedown credit. Damage taken during Stagger 's protective period is calculated and stored after all reductions, causing its damage reduction to stack multiplicatively with other defensive damage modifiers, like Armor, that were active at the same time. Does not prevent or store damage to Shields.

abilities.name: Wandering Keg
abilities.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.; 60; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Defensive damage modifier, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect,Knockback, Mobile channel, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Chen can not attack, use his Abilities or stop during Wandering Keg. Colliding with an enemy removes the Movement Speed bonus which is then regained over 0.375 seconds.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
abilities.description: After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability. The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well. Storm can grant the spirits a Shield. Earth can leap to an area and Slow Enemies. Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed and damage. Storm Earth Fire ; 120; heroic

fields.notes: Earth's Basic Attacks splash in 3.5 radius, dealing Spell Damage and Slowing enemies within 3.5 radius of the primary target by 25% for 1.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire - Storm
abilities.description: The spirits gain a Shield for 400 over 3 seconds. If this is the final Ability cast, the Shield amount is increased to 750 with unlimited duration and the duration of Storm, Earth, Fire is increased by 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire - Earth
abilities.description: Fire and Earth leap to the target location dealing 32 damage and Slowing enemies in a large area by 70% for 1.5 seconds. If this is the final Ability cast, increase the damage dealt by 300% and instead of Slowing, the leap Roots enemy Heroes hit for 1.75 seconds.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch
fields.notes: Empowered leap bonus damage stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers. After the leap, Storm and Earth will attack the closest target within their acquisition range, if no attack command is issued.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire - Fire
abilities.description: Increase the Attack Speed and Basic Attack damage of the spirits by 50% for 5 seconds. If this is the final Ability cast, the Attack Speed and damage bonus is increased to 75% and the spirits gain 50% Movement Speed for its duration.

fields.props: Attack Modifier, Attack Speed, Movement Speed
fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

talents.name: Accumulating Flame
talents.description: Quest Damage enemy Heroes with Breath of Fire to permanently increase periodic damage by 0.25. Kills grant 2. After gaining 25 damage, increase the range of Keg Smash. Reward Upon gaining 80 damage, Breath of Fire reduces enemy Armor by 20 and its duration is increased by 0.75 seconds each time Chen attacks the Hero.

fields.notes: Does not increase the duration of Brew-soaked debuff. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Breath of Fire 's damage.

talents.name: Energizing Brew
talents.description: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Stacks additively with other damage modifiers affecting Chen's damage output. Energizing Brew buff is removed upon successfully casting Storm, Earth, Fire. Health increase is based on Chen's maximum Health regardless of Chen's current Health. Upon expiration, Chen retains any Health gained through Energizing Brew that does not exceed his base maximum Health.
